# Greeter

Greeter prints a greeting for each name you pass it. It has no options.

Run it with one name:

```sh
sh src/greet.sh Sam
```

The [install guide](docs/install.md#check-it-works) covers setup, and `src/greet.sh` holds the code.

| Name | Prints |
| --- | --- |
| Sam | Hello, Sam |
| Lee | Hello, Lee |
